newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY STABLE TO WEAKER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY STABLE TO WEAKER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed on Thursday stable against the rand but was quoted softer against other hard currencies after a fairly brisk interbank session, dealers said.
They added however that the unit had recovered from it's morning lows after the central Reserve Bank injected a few U.S. dollars into the market to ease import pressure.
"The dollar firmed slightly from where it was in the morning. Many guys got some money from the Reserve Bank and the market closed squarish or even a bit long," one dealer said.

Most dealers said they were still cautious and narrowing their spreads gradually towards the normal two points following a volatile two weeks or so which saw people quoting spreads as wide as 10 to 15 points.

At Thursday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted at 10.2200/2700 against the U.S. unit, up from 10.2200/2800 in the morning but down from 10.2000/2700 overnight, while on sterling it was at 16.0360/1200 from late Wednesday's 15.9790/16.0775.
It slipped to 6.8910/9275 versus the mark from 6.8700/9120 the previous day but was little changed at 2.2720/2840 from 2.2720/2870 against the rand.
